definitions.explanation: The night or evening of the previous day. Can also be written as {昨夜|ゆうべ}.

examples.english: What did you do last night?

examples.japanese: ゆうべ⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}れなかった→眠る：01181_nemuru⟧。
examples.english: I couldn't sleep well last night.

examples.japanese: ゆうべ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{面白|おもしろ}かった→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧。
examples.english: The movie last night was interesting.

examples.japanese: ゆうべ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: Last night I went out to eat with a friend.

examples.japanese: ゆうべ⟦{遅|おそ}く→遅い：00533_osoi⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}していた→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}い→眠い：00872_nemui⟧。
examples.english: I was studying until late last night, so I'm very sleepy today.

notes:
Time word referring to the previous night. Usually written in hiragana but can also be {昨夜|ゆうべ}. Note that {昨夜|さくや} is a more formal reading.

RELATED TIME WORDS:
・⟦{今夜|こんや}→今夜：01411_konya⟧ (tonight)
・⟦おととい→おととい：00877_ototoi⟧ (day before yesterday)
・⟦{昨日|きのう}→昨日：00859_kinou⟧ (yesterday)
・⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧ (tomorrow)
・⟦あさって→あさって：00828_asatte⟧ (day after tomorrow)
